sentences.text: San Diego Comic-Con International is a multi-genre entertainment and comic convention held annually in San Diego , California , United States .	San Diego	San Diego	California	California	United States	United States	convention	fan convention

It was founded as the Golden State Comic Book Convention in 1970 by a group of San Diegans that included Shel Dorf , Richard Alf , Ken Krueger and Mike Towry ; later , it was called the `` San Diego Comic Book Convention '' .	San Diego	San Diego	Shel Dorf	Shel Dorf	Richard Alf	Richard Alf	Ken Krueger	Ken Krueger	Mike Towry	Mike Towry
The name , as given on its website , is Comic-Con International : San Diego ; but it is commonly known simply as Comic-Con or the San Diego Comic-Con or `` SDCC '' .	San Diego	San Diego

It is a four-day event -LRB- Thursday -- Sunday -RRB- held during the summer at the San Diego Convention Center in San Diego .	San Diego Convention Center	San Diego Convention Center	San Diego	San Diego
On the Wednesday evening prior to the official opening of the event , there is a preview for professionals , exhibitors , and select guests pre-registered for all four days .

Comic-Con International also produces two other conventions , WonderCon , held in Los Angeles , and the Alternative Press Expo -LRB- APE -RRB- , held in San Francisco .	WonderCon	WonderCon	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	Alternative Press Expo	Alternative Press Expo	San Francisco	San Francisco

Since 1974 , Comic-Con has bestowed its annual Inkpot Award on guests and persons of interest in the popular arts industries , as well as on members of Comic-Con 's board of directors and the Convention committee .	Inkpot Award	Inkpot Award

Originally showcasing primarily comic books and science fiction/fantasy related film , television , and similar popular arts , the convention has since included a larger range of pop culture and entertainment elements across virtually all genres , including horror , animation , anime , manga , toys , collectible card games , video games , webcomics , and fantasy novels .	convention	fan convention	pop culture	popular culture	horror	horror fiction	anime	anime	manga	manga	video games	video games	webcomics	webcomics	fantasy	fantasy
